notes.title: The Hope - Update 15th June
notes.content:
Various fixes:

- resolved a bug where if you save the game and reload it on the last checkpoint a loading widget would be in loop

- resolved a bug where few materials would not appear properly and would be grey


Added a hint to toggle flashlight when you die/load last checkpoint.

Improved stability.

If you have any issues with your saving/loading from previous update please go to C:\users\(your username)\appdata\local\ and delete "The Hope" folder.

notes.title: The Hope - Update 8th June
notes.content:
[u][b]Various Bugs fixed:[/b][/u]

- Resolved a bug where when interacting with the doors players would be able to open/close them from long distances

- Resolved a bug where after interacting with the church you would not be able to interact with the doors after

- Resolved a bug where some materials would disappear and would not render properly

notes.title: The Hope Update 2 - 1st June
notes.content: - Resolved a bug where multiple lighting points would appear on the map.

notes.title: The Hope Update - 1st June
notes.content:
[u][b]Bugs Fixed:[/b][/u]

- Resolved a bug where the lights from the candles would not display properly.

- Resolved a bug where some shadows would not appear properly on the screen.

- Resolved a bug where some meshes would not render properly unless the character is closed to them.


[u][b]Greatly increased performance[/b][/u]

- Performance has been increased greatly. Quality on rendering meshes have been reduced in order to improve FPS

- Shadows have been created manually in order to improve FPS

- Lighting has been modified in order to improve FPS

notes.title: The Hope Update 2 - 18th May
notes.content:
[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

- resolved a bug where if "low" effects quality was selected some meshes/assets were invisible

- resolved a bug where if you used the option in game and pressed the button "back" the mouse cursor would be still on the screen

- resolved a bug where steps audio would not have the correct steps sound effects.

- resolved a bug where some texture would loose their quality.

[b]Adjusted some collisions [/b]

For any bugs please contact support!

notes.title: The Hope Update notes for 18th May
notes.content:
[u][b]Bugs Fixes:[/b][/u]

- resolved a bug where not displaying correct hints "press W,A,S,D to move"

- resolved a bug where if you go to the church one of the house's stairs would block the player going up

- resolved a bug where trees would go through the house

- resolved a bug when interacting with the Bible, the audio and the widget format would be duplicated.
